title: bun run format passes . to biome and breaks when a .claude/worktrees review worktree exists
description:
bun run format runs `biome format --write .`. Passing `.` makes biome scan the whole tree, including .claude/worktrees/<name>/ when a DEC-183 review worktree exists there. That nested checkout carries its own biome.json, so biome aborts with a nested-root-configuration error and exits 1.

`format:check` -- and therefore `bun run check` and CI -- passes the EXPLICIT path list and is unaffected; CI never has a worktree, so this is local-only, which is why it is low priority. It is the known review-worktree class (worktrees breaking local lint).

Found 2026-10-14 while creating .claude/worktrees/quest-cli-review-615 for PR opum-ai/quest-cli#615.

Fix (folded into the QCLI-501 PR, per team-lead): give `format` the same explicit path list `format:check` uses (src test scripts hooks types tests biome.json package.json tsconfig.json).
finalSummary:
Fixed in the QCLI-501 PR, as team-lead directed: the `format` script now passes the same explicit path list `format:check` uses (src test scripts hooks types tests biome.json package.json tsconfig.json) instead of `.`, so biome no longer scans .claude/worktrees/ and no longer aborts on a nested biome.json.

Verified: with .claude/worktrees/quest-cli-review-615 present, `bun run format` now exits 0 ("Formatted 262 files ... No fixes applied."); before the fix it exited 1 with "Found a nested root configuration". `format:check` and CI were already unaffected, so this is local-only.
